nodes.name: po-receiving.test.ts
nodes.summary: Smoke-test file for the purchase order receiving module, importing po-receiving and session to verify basic module loading.

nodes.name: po-receiving.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the core goods-receiving workflow for purchase orders, including receipt validation, inventory posting, PO status refresh, and AP payment recording against received goods.

nodes.name: getPurchaseOrderForReceiving
nodes.summary: Fetches a purchase order with its lines for the receiving workflow by tenant and PO id.

nodes.name: validateAndApplyPoLineReceipts
nodes.summary: Validates receipt quantities against PO lines and persists received quantities in a database transaction, then refreshes PO status.

nodes.name: postInventoryForPoReceipts
nodes.summary: Looks up SKUs by code and calls receiveStock for each received PO line, propagating unit cost to the inventory ledger.

nodes.name: receivePurchaseOrderGoods
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the full goods-receipt flow: validates and applies PO line receipts, posts inventory, and triggers AP bill creation.

nodes.name: recordPoPayment
nodes.summary: Records a payment against a purchase order, optionally synchronizing with the AP bill and posting an AP payment journal entry.

nodes.name: pos-receipt.ts
nodes.summary: Generates an HTML receipt document for a point-of-sale order, querying order and tenant data then rendering a styled receipt template.

nodes.name: buildPosReceiptHtml
nodes.summary: Fetches tenant and order data and renders an HTML receipt with line items, totals, tax, and payment info for a POS transaction.

nodes.name: pos.ts
nodes.summary: Provides point-of-sale register management and order creation, orchestrating stock commitment, serial enforcement, order status transitions, and audit logging for POS transactions.

nodes.name: createPosOrder
nodes.summary: Creates a POS order end-to-end: validates feature flags, creates the base order, checks payment, commits inventory, enforces serial tracking, transitions order status, and writes an audit log.

nodes.name: pricing.ts
nodes.summary: Manages customer-specific pricing contracts and volume price breaks, providing resolution logic that applies tiered pricing when determining unit prices for orders.

nodes.name: resolvePricesForCustomer
nodes.summary: Resolves effective unit prices for a set of SKUs for a given customer, combining contract prices, volume break pricing, and list prices into a result map.

nodes.name: assertOrderLinePrices
nodes.summary: Validates that each order line's submitted unit price matches the resolved customer price within a tolerance, throwing if any mismatch is detected.

nodes.name: purchasing.ts
nodes.summary: Exposes the full purchase order lifecycle (create, submit, cancel, receive, payment) and supplier CRUD, delegating goods-receipt logic to po-receiving.

nodes.name: createPurchaseOrder
nodes.summary: Creates a new purchase order with line items after validating the supplier exists within the tenant.

nodes.name: updatePurchaseOrderLandedCosts
nodes.summary: Updates freight, duty, and insurance landed-cost fields on a purchase order and persists the changes.

nodes.name: quotes.ts
nodes.summary: Manages B2B quote lifecycle including creation, approval workflow, counter-offers, and conversion to sales orders, integrating with CRM and inventory for line resolution.

nodes.name: createQuote
nodes.summary: Creates a new B2B quote record with line items in the storefront database for the given tenant.

nodes.name: submitQuote
nodes.summary: Converts an approved B2B quote into a sales order by resolving line items and customer identity, then marks the quote as submitted.

nodes.name: saved-payment-methods.ts
nodes.summary: Manages customer saved payment methods (card/ACH tokens), supporting list, save, delete, and default-setting operations against the payment database.

nodes.name: search.ts
nodes.summary: Provides a cross-entity global search function querying orders, customers, SKUs, and B2B quotes simultaneously using full-text prefix matching.

nodes.name: session.ts
nodes.summary: Provides JWT-based session management including token verification, role-assertion helpers, an ApiError class, and user-state caching with cache invalidation.

nodes.name: getSession
nodes.summary: Parses and verifies the Bearer JWT from a request, then revalidates the user's active status and tenant membership, returning a typed session object.

nodes.name: ApiError
nodes.summary: Custom error class carrying an HTTP status code and message for structured API error responses.

nodes.name: stripe.ts
nodes.summary: Wraps the Stripe SDK to provide payment intent authorization, ACH processing, capture, void, refund, and webhook signature verification for the ERP payment subsystem.

nodes.name: authorizePayment
nodes.summary: Creates a Stripe PaymentIntent in manual-capture mode for card authorization, returning the intent ID and client secret.

nodes.name: tenant-tax.ts
nodes.summary: Manages per-tenant sales tax rate configuration stored in the tenant organization record, providing get and update helpers.

nodes.name: tenant.ts
nodes.summary: Provides tenant management operations including profile patching, plan updates, onboarding step tracking, and team invitation creation and revocation.

nodes.name: createInvite
nodes.summary: Creates a team invite token for a given email/role, persists it with expiry, and fires an invite notification email.

nodes.name: patchOnboardingStep
nodes.summary: Updates a specific onboarding step's completion state and marks the tenant as fully onboarded when all steps are done.

nodes.name: tier2.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration test file for Tier 2 ERP features, exercising compliance tax, credit limit, and dispatch order modules.

nodes.name: tier8.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration test file for Tier 8 ERP features, exercising AP bills, compliance tax, and general ledger journal posting modules.

nodes.name: users.ts
nodes.summary: Provides paginated user listing, user deactivation, and role/profile update operations for tenant administrators, invalidating session cache on changes.

nodes.name: updateUser
nodes.summary: Updates a user's role and profile fields, validates against the allowed role list, and invalidates the session cache to force revalidation.

nodes.name: wave-picking.ts
nodes.summary: Manages warehouse pick wave creation, lifecycle (start, complete), and detailed pick wave retrieval with bin-sorted pick lines using the pick-bin-resolver.

nodes.name: getPickWaveDetail
nodes.summary: Returns a full pick wave with enriched pick lines (bin locations resolved) sorted by bin code for optimized picker routing.

nodes.name: webhooks.ts
nodes.summary: Manages webhook subscription CRUD with SSRF protection (private IP blocking, DNS resolution check) and HMAC-SHA256 payload signing, plus a test-fire endpoint.

nodes.name: assertSafeWebhookUrl
nodes.summary: Validates a webhook URL is not targeting private/internal IP ranges by checking both direct IP addresses and DNS-resolved addresses, guarding against SSRF attacks.

nodes.name: wms-cycle-count.ts
nodes.summary: Manages warehouse cycle count workflows including creation with smart line selection (ABC/random/location modes), count entry, approval, and inventory adjustment posting.

nodes.name: approveCycleCount
nodes.summary: Approves a cycle count by computing adjustment deltas for each variance line and posting stock adjustments to inventory, collecting any errors before marking the count closed.

nodes.name: createCycleCount
nodes.summary: Creates a cycle count record and populates its lines by selecting stock levels based on the configured count type (ABC, random, or location-based).

nodes.name: wms-fulfillment.ts
nodes.summary: Core WMS fulfillment module managing pick task lifecycle from creation through line confirmation, packing, and dispatch, including labor event recording and bin-enriched line display.

nodes.name: confirmPickLine
nodes.summary: Records a picker's confirmation of a pick line quantity, updates pick and task status, fires a labor event, and returns the refreshed task.

nodes.name: listFulfillmentTasks
nodes.summary: Lists fulfillment tasks with optional status, warehouse, and order filters, enriching each task's pick lines with bin location data.

nodes.name: markFulfillmentPacked
nodes.summary: Transitions a fulfillment task to PACKED status after verifying all pick lines are picked, and triggers the order-orchestration packed callback.

nodes.name: wms-labor.ts
nodes.summary: Records warehouse labor events (pick, putaway, receive) and computes per-worker productivity metrics over a rolling time window.

nodes.name: wms-putaway.ts
nodes.summary: Manages WMS putaway tasks generated from receiving sessions, providing bin suggestion, task creation, and line confirmation with stock bin-level updates.

nodes.name: confirmPutawayLine
nodes.summary: Confirms a putaway line by validating the target bin, moving stock to the bin location, updating task completion status, and recording a labor event.

nodes.name: wms-receiving.ts
nodes.summary: Manages WMS receiving sessions for scanning goods into the warehouse, including PO-linked pre-population, item scan, session completion with inventory receipt, and putaway task creation.

nodes.name: completeReceivingSession
nodes.summary: Finalizes a receiving session by posting stock receipts to inventory, syncing PO receipt records, updating backorder fills, and spawning a putaway task.

nodes.name: scanReceivingItem
nodes.summary: Processes a barcode scan during receiving, resolving the SKU, matching against expected items, and creating or updating receiving item records.
